An '''individual''' served as the [[President/Legends|president]] of the elite [[Leadership School]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Andara/Legends|Andara]]<ref name="School">''[[Jedi Quest: The School of Fear]]''</ref> in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he met with the undercover [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]], who were attempting to [[Mission to Andara|infiltrate]] the school.<ref name="School" />
